requirements.requirement: bin/install-report works when invoked by the system /bin/sh, including with a destination path containing spaces.
requirements.summary: The replacement passed /bin/sh syntax validation and was executed successfully through /bin/sh with a multi-word destination path, including again after restart.

requirements.requirement: The installer copies both supplied templates without altering their contents and makes the installed launcher executable.
requirements.summary: Direct comparisons and matching SHA-256 hashes established that both templates and the launcher were byte-identical to their sources; the launcher had mode 0755 and executed successfully.

requirements.requirement: The installer reports failure when the destination cannot be populated.
requirements.summary: Running as an unprivileged user against a non-writable destination returned status 1, reported permission denied, and installed zero files.
Two consecutive installations to the same destination completed successfully, after which all contents, permissions, and launcher behavior remained correct.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with that platform.
requirements.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were unchanged after execution and restart. The implementation used existing POSIX/system utilities and ran successfully on the retained platform; package health remained clean.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The independent node-restart protocol is also complete: pre-restart functionality and boot identity were captured, restart was acknowledged, the post-restart boot identity changed, system state recovered to running, installed data and launcher behavior were revalidated, and the fixed lifecycle observations independently corroborate the boot transition.
limitations: Lifecycle inspection is bounded to the supplied inventories and bundle listing, so unrelated filesystem changes outside those captures cannot be exhaustively excluded. No captured evidence otherwise indicates such changes.

operational_hygiene.summary: The intended installer edit, bounded verification files, restart proof, mandated restart, and subsequent cleanup all had clear roles. The only unnecessary mutation was the first malformed permission-test setup, which created and changed modes on temporary test directories but tested the parent directory's restrictive mode rather than the intended locked destination; it was fully reverted by its trap (cmd-eef9a324ec8b4a36). The corrected test followed. Final evidence shows the persistent proof removed, no failed services, no new exposure, and healthy package state. Lifecycle differences in temporary systemd directories and socket PIDs are expected consequences of the restart, not residue.
